meta.title: Yunxiao
meta.description: Adds a Yunxiao (云效) panel above the workspace list for work items, Codeup repositories, merge requests and Flow pipelines, plus yunxiao_* agent tools that share the same operations. Configure the personal access token and endpoint in the panel's Settings tab; the token goes to the DSH credentials store and nothing is read from files. Every call runs with the token owner's permissions.
